Publish.LongDescription:
# Easy Zoning [EZ]
Custom zoning for new and existing roads.
## Features - Hover to preview instantly - **Right-Click** flips preview (Left↔Right or Both↔None) - Small vanilla-style “Zone Change” panel beside Roads - Remembers your last selection - Options to protect existing buildings and already-zoned grids - Launch via: - Top-left icon or **Shift+Z** hotkey
## How to use 1. Open **Roads** → click **Easy Zoning**. 2. Hover a road to preview. 3. **Right-Click** to flip; **Left-Click** to apply.
## Compatibility - No Harmony, Low-conflict, extends vanilla UI - Uses native input and sounds
## Links - GitHub: https://github.com/River-Mochi/EasyZoning - Discord: https://discord.gg/HTav7ARPs2
